question: Between April 1 and July 31 of 2017, using the hits product revenue data along with the totals transactions to classify sessions as purchase (transactions ≥ 1 and productRevenue not null) or non-purchase (transactions null and productRevenue null), compare the average pageviews per visitor for each group by month
sql:
WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews,
    SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) as transactions,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(h.product) AS p WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
    ) as has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as session_month,
    pageviews,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND NOT has_product_revenue THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_data
  WHERE (transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue) OR (transactions IS NULL AND NOT has_product_revenue)
)
SELECT 
  session_month,
  session_type,
  AVG(pageviews) as avg_pageviews_per_visitor
FROM classified
GROUP BY session_month, session_type
ORDER BY session_month, session_type
